items.title: How does the timing gap scale with the number of operations?
items.description: Using the exact per-operation timings measured in L3 on identical 32-byte payloads (symmetric ~0.0284ms, asymmetric private-key ~0.5546ms), drag the number of decrypt operations to see total time for each approach. At 500 operations, this reproduces L3's actual measured result (14.2ms vs 277.3ms).
